visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of text-only linked tiles (section title and short description)
visualCharacteristics.description: Grid of 8 light-blue (#edf2fa) link tiles (section title + short description), wraps to rows; heading is visually hidden.

contentPattern.summary: Text-only linked tiles (title + short description) on light-blue backgrounds, wrapping grid.
contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: linked title (heading or paragraph) and a short description. The first link makes the whole tile clickable
contentPattern.sourceContent: 8 linked items: Chi siamo, Sistema elettrico, Progetti e territorio, Sostenibilità, Investitori, Governance, Persone, Media

usage: Homepage "Navigazione pagine di sezione" grid of 8 section links.
reuseGuidance: Use for section/landing navigation tiles. For colored promos with eyebrow and CTA use cards-promo.
